title: Half of all sportsbook-months deducted between $1.90 and $5.53 of free play per $100 wagered; 9% deducted $10 or more
Three sportsbooks took 77% of all dollars wagered; the nine smallest took 6% together
The most free play per $100 came from two smaller tribal sportsbooks, not from FanDuel or DraftKings
Tribal sportsbooks paid no state tax in 74% of months in 2021 and 20% in 2026; commercial ones swung between 0% and 56%
Tribal sportsbooks deducted $9.05 per $100 in their first six months and $2.52 after four years; commercial ones stayed near $4
Among things known before the month starts, each target is most closely tied to its own value the month before (0.59 and 0.79)
Model 1 accounts for 36% of the differences in free play per $100; its typical miss is $5.46
